data.name: Silly Soccer Mini-Game: Dribble Master
data.detailed_description:
This is a hilarious, stress-relieving soccer survival sim full of wild ideas. Ditching complex traditional soccer mechanics like passing, shooting and tactical battles, it only retains pure, thrilling evasion survival gameplay. It’s super easy to pick up, so you can start a casual match anytime, anywhere.

The core goal of the game is straightforward: simply move your character freely around the pitch and protect your soccer ball from the crazy defensive foes scattered across the field. You’ll face all kinds of bizarre opponents: some charge straight at the ball with high-speed sliding tackles, others continuously spew disruptive exhaust fumes from a fixed distance, some alternate between chasing and retreating to cut off your movement, and swarms of minions will spawn to surround you layer by layer, creating chaotic, absurdly funny scenes.

Your only job is to dodge all incoming threats with nimble positioning, sudden stops, quick turns and looping kiting. No complicated controls are needed—just predict enemy paths and keep a safe gap to guard the ball. The challenge ends instantly once the ball gets touched by any foe; the longer you stay alive, the higher your score, testing your reflexes and kiting skills.

data.short_description: This is a wacky and funny football evasion survival mini-game with ultra-simple controls—you only need to move your character. Hordes of enemies will rush toward your soccer ball relentlessly; do not let them touch it. The longer you survive, the higher your score. How long can you last?
